name: ONGEKI
source:
In a seemingly distant yet near future—
A story set in a world where "Ongeki", the next-generation competitive game hailed as the evolution of music games, has become commonplace. 

Akari Hoshizaki, Aoi Misumi and Yuzu Fujisawa, three close friends attending Kanadezaka High School, had a big dream. 

It was to fill the stage with emotion through the dazzling world of Ongeki!
A sparkling stage, heart-stirring music, and cheers flying through the air—
just like that stage they once saw and longed for!

[Translated from [url=https://ongeki.sega.jp/introduction/]official website[/url]]
translation:
在看似遥远却又不远的未来——
故事发生在被誉为音乐游戏进化的次世代竞技游戏“Ongeki”已经变得司空见惯的世界。

星崎明里、三澄葵和藤泽柚子是金坂高中的三位好朋友，他们有一个远大的梦想。

就是要通过令人眼花缭乱的音激世界，让舞台充满情感！
闪闪发光的舞台，震撼人心的音乐，空气中飞扬的欢呼声——
就像他们曾经见过、向往的那个舞台一样！

[翻译自[url=https://ongeki.sega.jp/introduction/]官网[/url]]
